TEHSIL/SUB‑DIVISIONAL
ZAKAT AND USHR COMMITTEES (CONSTITUTION) RULES, 1979
[Gazette of Punjab, Extraordinary, 11th March, 1980]
No. PZA/79/216‑Zakat.‑----In pursuance of the
provisions of section 16 of the Zakat and Ushr (Organisation) Ordinance, 1979
at the direction and with the approval of the Central Zakat Council, the Punjab
Zakat Council makes the following Rules for the constitution of the Local
Committee and the Tehsil/Sub‑Divisional Committees, within the province
of the Punjab-----
1. Short title, application and commencement.‑(1)
These rules may be, called the Local and the Tehsil/Sub‑Divisional Zakat
and Ushr Committees (Constitution) Rules. 1979.
(2) These shall apply to the constitution of all the Local
Committees and the Tehsil/Sub‑Divisional Committees in the province.
(3) These shall come into force at once.
2. Definitions.‑In these rules unless there is any
thing repugnant in the subject or context,‑
(a) "adult" means a person who is major as
defined in section 3 of the Majority Act, 1875 (No. IV of 1875)
(b) "appointed place" means the place/venue
fixed by the District Committee under sub‑rule (1) of rule 5, for the
selection of members or for the election of the Chairman of a Local Committee ;
(c) `appointed time' means the date and time fixed by the
District Committee under sub‑rule (1) of rule 5, for the selection of
members or for the election of the Chairman of a Local Committee ;
(d) "Chairman" means the Chairman of a Local
Committee ;
(e) "Convenor" means the Convenor of a Team
nominated under sub -rule (2) of rule 4 ;
(f) "election" means the election of the
Chairman of a Local, Com mittee ;
(g) "gathering" means the gathering of adult
Muslim residents of the locality present at the appointed place and appointed
time ;
(h) `member' means a member of a Local Committee ;
(i) "Ordinance" means the Zakat and Ushr
(Organisation) Ordinance, 1979 ;
(j) "publicity" means publicity through all
possible means like the heat of drum, us;, of loudspeaker, putting up notices
at prominent public places, announcement in the mosques, etc. ;
(k) "selection" means the selection of a member
of a Local Committee ; and
(l) "Team" means a team constituted under sub‑rule
(1) of rule 4.
3. Delimitation of localities.‑The District
Committee, in pursuance of the provisions of section 9 of the Ordinance and
subject to any directions received from the Provincial Council shall delimit
clearly and unambiguously the localities in the district and shall give widest
possible publicity to such delimitation, amongst the adult Muslim residents of
the localities concerned.
4. Constitution and functions of the Team.‑(I) The
District Committee shall constitute Team each consisting of two or more persons
including at least one non‑official to organize selection of members and
selection of Chairman of Local Committees.
(2) The District Committee shall nominate one of the
members of a Team to be the Convenor of that Team. The Convenor shall be the
leader of the Team and act as its spokesman.
(3) The District Committee shall require each Team to
organise selection of members and election of Chairman in0 one or more
localities.
(4) The composition and jurisdiction of the Teams shall be
duly publicised by the District Committee.
5. Selection/Election programme of a Team and its
publicity.‑(1) District Committee shall give to every Team, a programme
of work indicating clearly the venue the date and the time of the
selection/election in each locality.
(2) The District Committee and the Teams shall give widest
possible publicity, in the localities concerned, to the programme of work given
to a Team under sub‑rule (1).
(3) The programme of work under sub‑rule (1) shall
be so planned by the District Committee that the residents of each locality get
at least seven days notice of the selection/election of their Local Committee.
